title: Show detailed information for a specific hardware component
summary: Use hwinfo with a specific component flag to view detailed technical information about one part of your system, like the CPU, network card, or USB devices.

steps.explain: Run hwinfo with the --component flag to display detailed information for a specific hardware type.

placeholders.name: COMPONENT
placeholders.description: The hardware component to query, e.g., cpu, memory, disk, gfxcard, network, usb, pci, keyboard, mouse, monitor, sound, fingerprint.
